rv.q: What emerges is a portrait of sexual frustration and romantic delusion so comprehensive and convincing that you feel as if you've been living with these people for years.
The Theatre Company gives the tri-part event an engaging revival, returning it to Broadway after 35 years.

cn.t: Critics praise Ayckbourn's ingeniously constructed trilogy as a comic masterwork, with the production earning acclaim for balancing sharp wit and genuine humanity while revealing darker truths beneath its polite English surfaces.

vs.sum: Broadway's only thrust-stage theater offers an unmatched intimate experience — no seat is more than a few rows from the action. Sightlines are excellent from every angle, though some seats face actors' backs during certain scenes.

acc.note: Elevator accessible through adjoining building. Loop technology and neck induction systems available.
